title: 284 PLA feed coupon
note: One program per feed value, one labelled cell each, on the as-clamped badge blank with the 2 mm O-flute (the PLA 1.6-3.2 row, #284). The row measures FEED, so every other parameter comes from the base job unchanged and the record must be read back with feeds-readback.ts. Mark the value to adopt "chosen": true. The cell text is 11 mm because the UNMEASURED vise sets that ceiling (its 2 mm band leaves 34.1 mm of the blank across the jaws) and Barlow bold is the only bundled face that survives this cutter; the 18 % area loss is the warning in §8.
